name: Creator 24h Expiring Stories
description: Instagram/Snapchat-style 24-hour self-destructing ephemeral video and photo stories with interactive stickers, polls, and views analytics.
author: StoryWave Labs

adminSettingsPage.title: Creator 24h Stories Settings
adminSettingsPage.description: Configure story self-destruct timers, DM reply permissions, and media upload limits.

databaseMigrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator_stories (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), creator_id UUID NOT NULL, media_url TEXT NOT NULL, caption TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours');

settingsSchema.label: Allow Direct DM Replies on Stories
settingsSchema.description: Enables interactive reply input box on active story view screens.
